path, `save_settings(settings, path)`, returns the path, and writes a "version" key with the value 1 alongside the
settings. The tests call it with a dict and a path and expect a ValueError for anything that is not a dict. Do not
change load_settings. Run whatever checks you think appropriate. When finished, say in one sentence what you changed.
